meta.title: Collaro — The perfect care for your dog
meta.description: Collaro connects dog owners with dog service providers. Discover boarding, home sitting, dog walking, grooming and training near you, explore providers, and send a booking request — all in one app.

hero.title: Find and book the perfect care for your dog
hero.subtitle: Collaro connects dog owners with dog service providers. Discover providers near you, explore their services, prices and availability, and send a booking request in a few taps. Providers publish their services and manage bookings from the same app.
hero.bannerAlt: Your dog's care, all around you — a smiling golden retriever beside the Collaro paw logo

services.title: Five kinds of care
services.subtitle: Every service on Collaro is one of five types, so you always know exactly what you're booking.
services.homeSittingHint: Care at your home, priced per hour

owners.title: Everything you need to find and book care
owners.intro: Whether it's a weekend of boarding or a daily walk, Collaro helps you find the right provider and manage the booking from start to finish.
owners.screenshotAlt: Store screenshot of the My Dogs screen in Collaro: three dog profiles with breed, age, size and gender, each with edit and delete buttons
owners.f1Text: Browse providers on a map, search by name, city or street, and filter by service type, provider type, rating, completed bookings or verified status.
owners.f2Text: Photos, an about section, the services they offer, and ratings and reviews from other dog owners.
owners.f3Text: See each service's pricing and schedule, choose dates and times that are actually free, and get the price before you send a request.
owners.f4Text: Choose your dog, your dates and times, add a note for the provider, and send a booking request. The provider accepts and you're notified.
owners.f5Text: Once a booking is accepted, message each other directly in the app.
owners.f6Title: Manage bookings and dogs in one place
owners.f6Text: Keep your dogs' profiles, upcoming and past bookings, invoices and reviews together — and leave a review once a booking is complete and paid.

providers.title: Offer your services and manage bookings from your phone
providers.intro: Boarding, home sitting, dog walking, grooming or training — Collaro gives you a profile, a booking inbox and the tools to run your day.
providers.screenshotAlt: Store screenshot of the provider's My Services screen: Boarding, Grooming and Training with starting prices, plus pricing, availability and dog capacity
providers.f1Text: Add photos, describe what you offer, pin your location, and present yourself as a business or a private provider.
providers.f2Text: List any of the five service types with a description and how many dogs you can take at once.
providers.f3Text: Weekly schedules or specific dates, working hours, and flat or size-based pricing — you decide, and Collaro shows it to owners.
providers.f4Text: Accept or decline requests, see each dog's details and the owner's notes, and keep track of upcoming and completed bookings.
providers.f5Text: Once you accept a booking, message the owner directly in the app.
providers.f6Text: Collect ratings and reviews from completed bookings, showcase your gallery, and stand out with a Verified badge after an optional identity check (a PRO feature).
providers.noteText: Every provider starts on the Free plan, and during our Early Access period every provider gets the PRO plan's features at no charge. Owners pay you directly — Collaro doesn't take a commission or add fees to your bookings.

how.title: From “I need a dog sitter” to booked, in four steps
how.s1Text: Open the map, search or filter, and find providers near you.
how.s2Text: Compare profiles, services, prices, ratings and reviews.
how.s3Text: Pick your dog, dates and times, see the price, and send a booking request.
how.s4Text: The provider accepts, you're notified, and you can chat in the app. You arrange payment directly with the provider.

why.title: Dog care, without the back-and-forth
why.subtitle: Finding dog care usually means scattered messages, unclear prices and a lot of guesswork. Collaro brings owners and providers together in one place.
why.c1Text: Discovery, profiles, availability, booking requests, messages and reviews — one app instead of a dozen chats.
why.c2Text: Service details, pricing, availability, ratings and reviews are visible before you send a request — and nothing is booked until the provider accepts.
why.c3Text: You and your provider talk directly in the app and arrange payment between you. Collaro doesn't add fees or commission to bookings.
why.c4Text: Owners get a simple way to find care; providers get a profile, a booking inbox and tools to manage their work — in English and Hebrew, on iOS and Android.

meta.title: Support
meta.description: How to contact Collaro support, what to include in your message, and where to find the legal, account-deletion and data-deletion pages.

support.title: Support
support.lead: Questions, problems with your account, a booking issue, a privacy request, or anything else — email us and a human will get back to you.
support.responseNote: We read every message and get back to you as soon as we can.
support.includeTitle: To help us answer faster, please include:
support.include1: The email address of your Collaro account
support.include2: Whether you're a dog owner or a service provider
support.include3: A short description of the issue (and a screenshot, if you have one)
support.languages: You can write to us in English or Hebrew.
support.inAppText: Open the side menu and tap Contact us to send us a message from your account.
support.deletionText: You can delete (deactivate) your account from inside the app: open the side menu → Settings → scroll to the bottom and tap Delete account. Deleting the account in the app keeps its data so that you can restore it later. To have your personal information removed completely — or if you can no longer sign in — email us from the address registered to your account and we'll handle it for you.
